#!/bin/bash
# starts the container under strace (attached to every thread of its pod's shim) and reads the run
L=/var/lib/bench65981878
cid=$1
sb=$($L/bin/crictl inspect -o go-template --template '{{.info.sandboxID}}' "$cid")
shim=""
for p in $(pgrep -x containerd-shim); do tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline | grep -q -- "-id $sb" && shim=$p; done
T=$(mktemp)
strace -f -qq -o "$T" -e trace=execve,mount $(for t in $(ls /proc/$shim/task); do printf -- '-p %s ' "$t"; done) 2>/dev/null &
SP=$!
sleep 2
msg=$($L/bin/crictl --timeout 120s start "$cid" 2>&1)
sleep 0.5
kill $SP; wait $SP 2>/dev/null
src=$(printf '%s' "$msg" | sed -n 's/.*error mounting \\*"\([^"\\]*\)\\*" to rootfs at.*/\1/p' | head -1)
dst=$(printf '%s' "$msg" | sed -n 's/.*to rootfs at \\*"\([^"\\]*\)\\*": mount.*/\1/p' | head -1)
flags=$(printf '%s' "$msg" | sed -n 's/.*flags: \(0x[0-9a-f]*\): .*/\1/p' | head -1)
runc=$(awk '/execve\("[^"]*\/runc", \["runc"/ {match($0, /"[^"]*\/runc"/); print substr($0, RSTART+1, RLENGTH-2); exit}' "$T")
line=$(grep -m1 -E 'mount\(.*\) += -1 E' "$T")
pid=$(printf '%s' "$line" | awk '{print $1}')
err=$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed -n 's/.* = -1 \(E[A-Z0-9]*\) .*/\1/p')
num=$(python3 -c "import errno,sys; print(getattr(errno, sys.argv[1]))" "$err")
sha=$(sha256sum "$runc" | cut -d' ' -f1)
rm -f "$T"
